params.sql: SELECT count("推奨度") AS responses, sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoters, sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detractors FROM data WHERE "推奨度" IS NOT NULL

source.inline: function main(input) { const n = Number(input.responses); const p = Number(input.promoters); const d = Number(input.detractors); if (!n) { throw new Error('no responses'); } const v = (p - d) / n * 100; const nps = Math.sign(v) * Math.round(Math.abs(v)); return { responses: n, promoters: p, detractors: d, nps: nps }; }
